mapper.insert: insert into buy_request(user_id, title, content, price_min, price_max, contact, status, like_count, comment_count, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{priceMin}, #{priceMax}, #{contact}, #{status}, 0, 0, now())
mapper.select: select r.*, u.username, p.avatar from buy_request r left join user u on u.id = r.user_id left join user_profile p on p.user_id = r.user_id where r.id = #{id} and r.status = 1

select r.*, u.username, p.avatar from buy_request r left join user u on u.id = r.user_id left join user_profile p on p.user_id = r.user_id where r.status = 1 order by r.like_count desc, r.comment_count desc, r.create_time desc limit #{top}

select count(1) from buy_request r left join user u on u.id = r.user_id
